question: With which field was Madhuri Barthwal associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Music**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madhuri Barthwal** is associated with the field of **Music**.
 
• She is known for her significant contributions to the promotion and preservation of folk music from the Uttarakhand region in India.
 
• Madhuri Barthwal has been recognized for her efforts in keeping the traditional music alive and passing it on to future generations.
 
• Her work includes not only performance but also the documentation and teaching of folk music traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Madhuri Barthwal has been honored with several awards for her contributions to music.
 
• Her efforts have played a crucial role in bringing the music of Uttarakhand to a broader audience.
 
• She continues to inspire many young musicians to explore and appreciate the rich musical heritage of their region.
